title: After the timelock the initiator reclaims its 5,000,000 CRC
description: At 10:06 the same call succeeds: Zeto unlocks the private tokens back to the sender and the record becomes HTLC_STATE_REFUNDED. The secret was never revealed, so no value crossed the corridor and the responder is not exposed.
notes: Gateway: Banco de San Jose commercial-bank gateway. This is the safety property the asymmetric timelock ordering buys: because the responder's lock always expires first, the responder can always refund before the initiator regains the ability to. Refund is idempotent — calling it on an already REFUNDED record returns 200 with the same hashes. Neither field of the 200 body is declared required by the platform; do not assume either hash is present.
